verses: Then I saw the soul of a woman whose breasts they cut off; and her belly was torn, and the entrails given to the dogs.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this woman?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked woman, by whom, in the world, poison and oil liquor? infusion? of opium were made and kept, and given by her to people to eat.
